title: Run moderated usability, accessibility, and localization study for deliver linked screen and diagram editing
summary: Observe real or representative operators completing `open repository-backed design truth, place screens and diagram objects, select and transform them, connect flows, inspect source context, and save` and convert usability, accessibility, localization, and trust evidence into proposed findings.
acceptance_criteria: Run a moderated or structured dogfood study over the complete journey: open repository-backed design truth, place screens and diagram objects, select and transform them, connect flows, inspect source context, and save.
Use a current revision and record device, OS, build, data fixture, locale, and accessibility settings.
Test at least the primary path, one realistic failure, and one recovery path.
Measure whether participants can state the current state, next action, and consequence of the action.
Capture task completion, critical errors, assistance, hesitation, backtracking, and abandonment.
Capture qualitative confidence and trust separately from task success.
Include VoiceOver or semantic review, keyboard or alternative input where relevant, scaling, contrast, focus, and reduced motion.
Include Czech and English or the repository's declared locale set with long and dynamic content.
Include compact and representative large device or window conditions.
Include offline, stale, permission-denied, or unavailable-service posture when the product supports them.
Do not expose credentials, private archives, customer, family, health, financial, or unreleased data to participants unnecessarily.
Use screen, interaction, and accessibility evidence only with prior consent.
Separate observed issue, severity, frequency, confidence, product impact, and suggested smallest safe fix.
Do not turn personal preference into a critical defect without contract or outcome evidence.
Compare findings against performance and assurance evidence.
Record contradictions and participant differences rather than hiding them.
Allow inconclusive results and request additional evidence where necessary.
Produce prioritized proposed findings with explicit non-scope.
Verify the study tooling and evidence export independently.
Store research evidence according to declared retention and withdrawal rules.
Update product review artifacts without starting implementation automatically.
Finish with zero app-owned warnings.

agent_notes: Portfolio Human Validation & Product Launch Wave 13.
Non-scope: do not release, deploy, sign, publish, enable billing or ads, operate hardware, write NAS data, migrate users, merge products, or create future game repositories.
Alternative considered and rejected: relying on internal confidence, green builds, or download counts without observed user or operator value would create false product certainty.
Research, telemetry, and feedback must remain privacy-safe, versioned, and optional where the product role requires it.

Final Wave 14 validity review: `valid-after-sudoku`; publication `publish-as-proposed-backlog`; implementation sequence `after-sudoku`. Human validation remains valuable after the product implementation prerequisites and Sudoku priority.
